## v0.5.32: A clearer save receipt and Memory Spaces' own settings / 更清楚的存入回执与记忆空间自带设置

Publishes the follow-ups to the review after v0.5.31, [#414](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/414)–[#430](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/430).

- On an install without an embedding service, a save without a vector now ends its receipt with a neutral note instead of an orange caution: keyword search still finds the memory, and its vector can be filled in once a service is connected. While DSH manages the embedding settings, a service that did not answer keeps the caution (#427).
- Memory Spaces brings its own settings, so it can change them without a dsh-mnemon release; they look and work as before (#421).
- Development and CI move to DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (npm `next`); the supported range is unchanged (#420).
- A new documentation gallery on DSH 0.2.1 with the live model and a local embedding service, restructured documentation, and a roadmap of the 22 changes still planned (#415, #417, #422, #424, #429, #430).
- For plugin authors: Strategy `workflows`, Source contracts that name their files and rules, new Memory Spaces, runtime memory and `dsh-mnemon/client` exports, and a compatibility register (#414, #416, #421, #423, #426, #427). The rest is internal, with nothing users or the model see changed: one table of memory tools (#418), test tooling out of pull request records (#419), one owner for shared values, wire types and sync checks (#426), and smaller Host and client modules (#425, #428).

发布 v0.5.31 之后那次审查的后续改动，[#414](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/414)–[#430](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/430)。

- 在没有嵌入服务的安装中，未生成向量的存入回执末尾改为中性的说明，不再是橙色警示：关键词检索不受影响，连接嵌入服务后可补齐向量。DSH 管理嵌入设置时，服务没有响应仍保留原有警示（#427）。
- 记忆空间自带设置，可以不随 dsh-mnemon 发布就修改它们；外观与行为不变（#421）。
- 开发与 CI 改用 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2（npm `next`）；支持范围不变（#420）。
- 在 DSH 0.2.1 上由真实模型与本地嵌入服务截取的新文档图集，重新组织的文档，以及列出其余 22 项计划改动的路线图（#415、#417、#422、#424、#429、#430）。
- 面向插件作者：策略的 `workflows`、给出自身文件与规则的 Source contracts、记忆空间、运行时记忆与 `dsh-mnemon/client` 新增的导出，以及兼容性登记表（#414、#416、#421、#423、#426、#427）。其余为内部改动，用户与模型看到的内容不变：记忆工具集中到一张表（#418），测试工具从 PR 记录移入仓库（#419），共享的值、通信类型与同步检查各归一处（#426），Host 与客户端模块拆得更小（#425、#428）。

The Starter advances to **0.5.32**, with runtime memory **0.5.15**, Project Documents **0.5.11**, Memory Spaces **0.5.22**, the Layered strategy **0.5.10** and Light context **0.5.6**. The other 12 component versions are unchanged. Existing memory needs no migration.

Starter 升至 **0.5.32**，运行时记忆升至 **0.5.15**，项目档案升至 **0.5.11**，记忆空间升至 **0.5.22**，分层策略升至 **0.5.10**，轻量上下文升至 **0.5.6**；其余 12 个组件版本不变，无需迁移已有记忆。

Use **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then restart DSH; on DSH 0.2.1 this needs 0.5.31 or later. From 0.5.30 or earlier on DSH 0.2.1, quit DSH, install the exact version once, then start DSH again:

使用**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**，然后重启 DSH；在 DSH 0.2.1 上需要 0.5.31 或更高版本。在 DSH 0.2.1 上从 0.5.30 或更早版本升级时，请退出 DSH，安装一次精确版本，再启动 DSH：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.32
```

Independently maintained copies in the Profile also need the new versions above.

Profile 独立维护的副本也需更新到上面的新版本。
